question: How close is the descriptive 999-permutation plot-label exceedance fraction to its 0.05 threshold, and how stable is its Monte Carlo numerical value conditional on the observed permutation design?
method: Recover K=999*original p rank minus one, calculate binomial Wilson 95% interval for empirical exceedance proportion K/999, compare observed gain to original 95% null threshold, report relative LOPO gain.
scope: Numerical uncertainty from finite random plot-label draws only. NOT ecological confidence interval, NOT validation of exchangeability or autocorrelation correction.
guardrails: No rereading the original woody or beetle species responses or site labels
No new permutations or tuning random seed after seeing original response
Wilson CI for simulation p does not become a confirmatory corrected ecological p-value
Do not alter full-method gate and frozen positive-exploratory label
Do not claim other islands or plant-beetle causality
